message: Reminders is now Alarms & Reminders. Set alarms of your own that repeat on the days you choose, or start a quick alarm for a nap in a couple of taps. An alarm can have a mission: with Pushups, you lay your phone under your chest and it counts each one, and the alarm rings again every 15 seconds after you stop it until they're done. A task can have a mission too, so checking it off means doing it first.
